title: Bulgari Rome vs Casa Monti: Polished Buzz or Boutique Fun? (2026) | Suites With Keith
description: Bulgari Hotel Roma vs Casa Monti, compared by a travel advisor who visited both in October 2026: two lively Rome hotels, room sizes, design, trattorias and rooftops, spa and gym, and who each one suits.

hero.alt: A Bulgari Hotel Roma terrace table under a white umbrella at sunset, looking over trees and rooftops
A Casa Monti room with an orange banquette under a scalloped arch of bird-print fabric and a green zigzag armchair

sub: Neither is a hushed grand hotel. Both have energy, a rooftop and a Roman trattoria close at hand. One is big, polished and marble; the other is small, playful and in Monti. Here is how I would choose.

choose.h3: If you want polish and space
choose.lead: Spectacular. Base rooms the size of junior suites elsewhere, marble and mosaics, the biggest gym I saw in Rome, and a lively scene that is much more sophisticated than an EDITION.
choose.alt: The entry hall of a Bulgari Hotel Roma room, with wood-paneled wardrobes and an oak floor

choose.h3: If you want hip, young and fun
choose.lead: So cute. A boutique hotel from the team behind Le Fantaisie in Paris, with super cool patterns, real trattorias all around and a spa couples can have to themselves.
choose.alt: Casa Monti’s downstairs restaurant, with striped banquettes, wicker chairs and a marble-fronted bar

band.h2: You want energy. Do you want it polished, or playful?
paras: The Bulgari is lively, almost like an EDITION but much more sophisticated. It is big and modern, with so many places to eat and drink that I’m not even sure how many there are.
Casa Monti is a boutique hotel for younger couples who want something hip, young and fun. The fun spills out the door into Monti, where real Romans eat at the trattorias.
If you want space, a big gym and everything under one roof, pick the Bulgari. If you are a younger couple who wants a small, playful hotel in a real neighborhood, pick Casa Monti.

guide.alt: A yellow vintage Fiat 500 with the Casa Monti logo outside the hotel’s arched entrance on Via Panisperna
paras: Casa Monti is surrounded by authentic Roman trattorias, and when I visited on a Sunday, real Romans were having lunch at them. Inside, there is a beautiful rooftop restaurant and a lively one downstairs.
The Bulgari brings the trattoria inside: a classic Roman one downstairs with dishes that are actually affordable, like €18 pastas. I loved that.

guide.alt: A Bulgari Hotel Roma base room with a tall upholstered headboard and a Bvlgari throw on the bed
paras: The Bulgari’s base rooms are what other hotels would sell as a deluxe room or a junior suite. You often don’t need to upgrade to get space.
At Casa Monti, the rooms are about personality: super cool patterns, details everywhere and curtains that hide the TV.

guide.alt: The Casa Monti spa pool, raised on golden marble steps between two white amphorae
paras: At Casa Monti, couples can book the spa just for the two of them. I arrange it before you arrive.
The Bulgari has the biggest gym I saw in Rome, massive and with serious equipment, plus a spa.

guide.alt: The Bulgari Hotel Roma rooftop at sunset, a brick walkway under green arches lined with lounge seating
paras: The Bulgari has a beautiful rooftop bar and pizza restaurant, and another bar on the floor below it.
Casa Monti’s rooftop restaurant is beautiful too, with terraces over the rooftops of Monti.

faq.q: Which is better, the Bulgari or Casa Monti?
faq.a: It depends on who is traveling. The Bulgari for space, polish and great dining without leaving the hotel. Casa Monti for younger couples who want something hip, young and fun in a real Roman neighborhood.

faq.q: Which is better for a honeymoon?
faq.a: For younger honeymooners, Casa Monti, and book the spa just for the two of you. The Bulgari suits travelers who want a big room and a lively scene.
The Bulgari. Its base rooms are what other hotels would call deluxe rooms or even junior suites.

Both are good for eating Roman. The Bulgari has a classic trattoria downstairs with €18 pastas, plus a rooftop bar and pizza restaurant. Casa Monti has a rooftop restaurant, a lively one downstairs, and authentic trattorias all around.
Neither is the pick for quiet. For calm in the middle of Rome, I send people to the Eden or the Corinthia.
